column1: Pound the chicken to an even thickness and season both sides with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat and brown the chicken 6–7 minutes, flipping once. Set aside under foil.
Off the heat, add the broth, lime juice, onion, cilantro, and red pepper flakes to the skillet. Return to heat and scrape up the browned bits.
Boil uncovered 10–12 minutes until reduced to about 1/2 cup.
Lower heat to medium-low, stir in the cream and butter until melted, then remove from heat.
Return the chicken to the skillet and turn to coat in the sauce.
Bake uncovered 5–10 minutes until the chicken reaches 165°F (74°C).
Serve with the sauce spooned over and garnish with lime and cilantro if desired.
